title: Account Ask Prioritization Bridge and Initial Scope Matrix
creator: Priya Rao
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable process ("bridge") for Sales/CS to normalize and prioritize account-specific feature requests and produce an initial scoping matrix that PMs and Engineering can action. This ticket delivers: 1) a short rubric to score ask signals from Sales/CS, 2) a templated matrix that captures business context, acceptance criteria, and rough effort bands, and 3) a handoff checklist for PM->ENG to convert scored asks into discovery or backlog items.
proposed_solution: Introduce a 4-step intake flow: Signal Normalizer (convert account language to standard ask types), Impact Scorer (weighted scoring across business value, revenue risk, feasibility, required compliance), Scope Matrix (auto-populated template with sample scope bands: quick-win / small / medium / large), and Handoff Checklist (links to PoC owners, analytics requirements, security flags). Produce Confluence template and a single-page note for Sales to run during quarterly account reviews.
scope_notes: Scope focuses on non-bug enterprise feature requests that originate from Sales/CS. Not in scope: infra-only platform work, on-call incident responses, and low-touch self-serve product asks. The matrix should support tagging for Dedicated/Private considerations (compliance, KMS), and indicate whether a Dedicated contract or Private deployment will materially change effort or priority.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence intake template published with fields: account context, ask summary, business metrics (ARR impact / risk), user journeys affected, security/compliance flags, rough effort band, proposed deadline
Scoring rubric documented with weights and example scored asks (3 sample accounts) showing how the priority changes when score components vary
Handoff checklist created with required attachments: prototype links, sample prompts/evals, logs/dashboard queries, stakeholder list
Pilot completed with Sales and two CSMs on three live asks and summary notes stored in the ticket
PM team trained in a 30-minute walkthrough and internal README added to the PM space
